ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Unrelenting.cs:18-21) == cost 2 / ATTACK / UNCOMMON / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(14m, ValueProp.Move)` (Unrelenting.cs:16) == `_damage = 14`, powered on both sides.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: attack FIRST (Unrelenting.cs:26-30), then `PowerCmd.Apply<FreeAttackPower>(..., 1m, ...)` (31) == `PowerCmd.apply(..., FreeAttackPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. The order is load-bearing -- the free-attack charge is granted after this card's own play, so it cannot pay for itself -- and is preserved. FreeAttackPower is one of the ported early-phase `TryModifyEnergyCostInCombat` pairs the hook_dispatch seam names as making its gaps G2 and G3 LIVE, and card/havoc's finding notes that a Havoc'd card never fires the `on_energy_spent` bracket that consumes this charge -- so Unrelenting is in that blast radius. Presentation, folded in: the Ironclad heavy-anim helpers, WithHitFx and WithHitVfxSpawnedAtBase.
